answer.summary: All 26 AttackPathHttpIsolationTest errors come from one deterministic DB guard: PL/pgSQL require_tenant_write refuses the test's INSERT INTO roles because the row's tenant is outside the transaction scope. The failure repeats on every run, not a flake (history shows 0 flakes), and the change adds the roles guard migration and tenant-scope logic, so re-running will likely fail the same way. Fix the test setup or the scope handling for role writes.
